name: Lock N Roll Storage
summary: Lock N Roll on Earl Rudder Freeway offers climate rooms, drive-up rooms, and vehicle parking near Texas A&M. Call for a price. The page tells you to use the unit list, and that list does not show dollar amounts.
address: 1501 Earl Rudder FWY, College Station, TX 77845

fees.label: Unit rates
fees.note: The page says prices are listed online and that they vary by size and by climate control. Checked again Nov 20, 2026. The facility page and the linked rental-center home still do not show a dollar amount before you start a move-in. A company-wide page says 5x5 units start at $39 a month somewhere in the chain. Do not use that as a College Station price.

fees.label: Lock fee
fees.note: Premium Spaces says its month-to-month rentals have no setup or admin fees beyond the first month and a small lock fee. The lock fee amount is not published, and the sentence is not repeated as a College Station price.

facts.label: Climate control
facts.value: The facility page lists both climate-controlled and non-climate storage, plus drive-up units.

facts.label: Students
facts.value: The page mentions student storage near Texas A&M and summer storage so students do not have to haul belongings home.

facts.label: Lease and reservation
facts.value: Month-to-month leases. The page says you can reserve online for free with no credit card.

facts.label: Other features
facts.value: Deliveries accepted, dollies, moving supplies, boat and RV storage, covered parking, a gate, and U-Haul trucks on site.

facts.label: Office and access hours
facts.value: The page has headings for today's office hours and today's access hours. The times are not listed. Call before you plan to get in.
